test_objective: Check that you can perform a partial update on an entity attribute

test_cases.name: 012_01_01 Check that you can partially update an attribute
test_cases.doc: Check that you can perform a partial update on an entity attribute
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Partial Update Entity Attributes with Response Status Code set to 204     and
        Retrieve Entity by Id with Check Updated Entity and
            Query Parameter: 'updated_resource' set to 'entity_expectation_payload' and
            Query Parameter: 'response_body' set to 'response1.json()' and
            Query Parameter: 'ignored_keys' set to 'ignored_attributes'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Request Partial Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: entityId set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: AttributeId set to 'isParked' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-isparked-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
